description: This file defines the ContentType class for Markdown content in Confluence format, extending a base class, and includes methods for creating a converter, adding JavaScript for rendering math and diagrams, and performing conversion with configuration-based toggles.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A class that handles Markdown content for Confluence format, adds support for math and mermaid diagrams via embedded scripts, and overrides conversion logic.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a Markdown converter instance with specific configuration.

methods.name: addJS
methods.description: Returns a string containing JavaScript code to render math blocks with KaTeX and diagram blocks with Mermaid.

methods.name: doConversion
methods.description: Performs content conversion by calling the parent method, conditionally appends JavaScript, and resets configuration flags.
